description.text: V Starter Deck: Evolution, a random 60-card deck, ready to play out of the box, with damage counters and a rule book. Its Pokémon VMAX include Flareon, Jolteon, Vaporeon and Espeon VMAX, and its Ice Rider and Shadow Rider Calyrex V carry attacks different from the cards in the Silver Lance and Jet-Black Spirit expansions. This set holds every card the decks could contain.
